title: Forecast 2040: pre-registered forecasting, event studies and ownership data for the German automotive industry
description: Code, data and results for a pre-registered research programme on the German automotive industry. The archive contains the rolling-origin forecast comparison of thirteen models on a panel of seventeen European markets, with the information split checked in Lean 4 and a conformal projection to 2040; the event study of the Volkswagen divestment programme, with a benchmark audit, a 23 firm peer comparison, a permutation test, GARCH volatility checks, a power analysis and six post hoc extensions; and the ownership register and capital cycle evidence for German industry. Every table and figure is rebuilt from the raw series by the scripts in the repository, and every input file carries a SHA256 hash in the manuscript.
